PASS_POINTS: Bulk invalidating pre-closure memberships by incrementing MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH is consistent with MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH being a bulk invalidation generation.
Separating post-pin read-only observers from normal MEMBERSHIP_RECORDs can preserve clause [197] participation without adding records to the clause [200] membership manifest.
Explicit empty-shard freeze acknowledgements and immutable manifest artifacts correctly preserve clauses [199], [200]-[209].

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.ISSUE: The candidate does not require the shard freeze state/acknowledgement to be serialized in the same authoritative CAS domain as normal membership mutation for that shard.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.RISK: If freeze acknowledgement is separate evidence, a stale writer can pass its earlier shard precondition and commit a normal membership write after freeze. The acknowledgement is then logically invalid, but invalidation is not atomically coupled to the write.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.ISSUE: COMPLETE_PRECONDITIONS require proving no normal membership write exists after freeze, but do not state a mechanism that makes this predicate stable through the final Mission Fence COMPLETE CAS.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.RISK: A write can race after the last revalidation and before COMPLETE CAS without changing Mission Fence STATE_VERSION, recreating the original pinned-world stale-completion counterexample.

REQUIRED_CHANGES: For each membership shard, place freeze state and membership mutation sequencing in one authoritative shard CAS domain, or use a transactional control store with equivalent atomicity.

A shard-freeze CAS must advance shard generation/head and mark the normal closure-membership namespace immutable; every normal membership write must bind the expected shard generation/head, so any stale pre-freeze writer fails its CAS after freeze.

Alternatively, atomically install in the Mission Fence a canonical immutable shard-snapshot mapping for the closure generation and define later mutable-shard writes as noncanonical for that closure generation; do not depend on absence-of-late-write polling.

The final COMPLETE CAS must bind a frozen-shard/root generation whose canonical value cannot change without either failing the COMPLETE expected-version CAS or forcing a prior authoritative transition visible to that CAS.

Add a torture test where a writer reads pre-freeze shard state, pauses, freeze succeeds, final revalidation succeeds, then the stale writer resumes immediately before COMPLETE CAS; the stale write must be rejected or provably noncanonical.
